explanation: The Simba article names the dead man in its own first paragraph as what the rising was for: the rebellion "was led by the followers of Patrice Lumumba, who had been ousted from power in 1960 by Joseph Kasa-Vubu and Joseph-Désiré Mobutu and subsequently killed in January 1961 in Katanga." Precondition-of and not caused: the article gives the killing as what the Lumumbists were, not as the event that started the rising two years later. Probable: Wikipedia alone (rule 22). Written to a record the atlas already held, under A5.
